policy: Owner-review decisions for crawl identities. A rename re-keys every power/depth overlay entry with that brand, name and source page (url_prefix) to the product the page actually describes. A rename marked not_module drops that page's entries and catalog rows: it is not a Eurorack module. catalog_rows are insert-if-absent, sourced from the maker's own page. Values are never written here; they stay in the overlays.
